headline: Record quarter as Data Center and ALM surge; guidance raised
summary_short: Iron Mountain's Q2 FY2026 revenue rose 18.5% y/y to $2,029M on record Data Center (+39%) and ALM (+88%) growth, GAAP net income of $101M swung from a year-ago loss, and the company raised full-year 2026 revenue, Adjusted EBITDA, and AFFO guidance.
summary_long: Revenue grew 18.5% y/y to $2,029M (release: +19% reported), led by Data Center (+39%) and ALM (+88% reported, +82% organic) outgrowing Global RIM (+8%). GAAP net income of $101M and diluted EPS of $0.34 swung from a year-ago loss. Adjusted EBITDA rose 16% to $727M, though margin compressed 90bp to 35.8% — a move the release doesn't explain. AFFO rose 17% to $433M; AFFO per share rose 16% to $1.44. Leverage held at 4.8x, within the 4.5x-5.5x target. Management raised FY2026 revenue, Adjusted EBITDA, AFFO, and AFFO/share guidance, and issued Q3 2026 guidance of roughly $1,980M revenue and $745M Adjusted EBITDA.
